notes: 2026 inflation-adjusted brackets and standard deduction published by the Minnesota Department of Revenue (Dec 2025). Minnesota has no personal exemption for the taxpayer/spouse (only a $5,300 dependent exemption, not modeled).

Standard deduction is reduced when AGI exceeds $244,400 ($122,200 MFS), with a steeper reduction above $337,800 ($168,900 MFS) and the reduction capped at 80% of the deduction (Minn. Stat. 290.0123, subd. 5); not modeled.

Not modeled: 1% net investment income tax on net investment income over $1 million; additions such as 80% bonus-depreciation add-back and Section 179 differences; Social Security/pension subtractions; Child and Working Family Credit; other credits.

2026 Session Laws ch. 128 (H.F. 2438) updated IRC conformity to May 1, 2026 and created a tax-relief account that may reduce the first-bracket rate by at least 0.1% for a following tax year if funded (determination each Dec 15); no reduction applies to tax year 2026 rates as published.

seDeduction.note: Minnesota starts from federal AGI, so the deductible half of SE tax (an above-the-line federal adjustment) is already excluded.

seHealthInsurance.note: The self-employed health insurance deduction is an above-the-line federal adjustment inherited through federal AGI.

retirementContributions.note: SEP-IRA and solo 401(k) deductions are above-the-line federal adjustments inherited through federal AGI.

qbi.note: The federal QBI deduction is taken after AGI, so it does not reduce the state base.

localIncomeTax.note: Minnesota cities and counties do not levy a local income tax.

estimatedTax.threshold: Minnesota income tax of $500 or more due after withholding, credits and refundable credits
estimatedTax.safeHarbor: Pay the lesser of 90% of the current year's tax or 100% of the prior year's total tax (110% if prior-year federal AGI was more than $150,000). No penalty if you had no 2025 Minnesota liability and were a full-year resident.
estimatedTax.form: Minnesota estimated tax payments (e-Services or Form M14 voucher); underpayment on Schedule M15

businessCosts.llcFormationFee: $155 Articles of Organization online or in person; $135 by mail
businessCosts.franchiseOrMinimumTax: None for a single-member LLC taxed as a disregarded entity or sole proprietor. (Partnerships and S corporations owe a minimum fee only when Minnesota property + payroll + sales are $1,280,000 or more for 2026, starting at $260.)
